about.title: About
about.body:
Hello! My name is Pedro, I'm a UX/UI Designer and Front-End Developer, focused on designing and building digital products.

For more than 4 years I've worked across design and development, creating websites, web applications, dashboards, SaaS interfaces, and other digital experiences. My work combines a strong eye for UI/UX with hands-on coding experience, letting me move from concept and prototyping to a fully functional product.

On the development side, I work mainly with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, WordPress and Tailwind CSS, along with experience integrating APIs and full-stack development when needed.

On the design side, I work in Figma and have a particular interest in UI Design, UX, Design Systems, interaction, visual hierarchy, and building interfaces that are both functional and visually refined.

I especially enjoy working at the intersection of design and technology: understanding a problem, structuring an experience, designing the interface, and turning it into a real, functional product.
